item.title: Candle Ad Without Photos

turns.text: I don't have a photo. Make a 15-second 9:16 ad for a candle: clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick, no label. Warm evening light, gentle camera moves and soft piano, no voice. Show “A little evening calm”, then finish with “Find your glow”.

item.tests: Tests generating a consistent product from a description alone and delivering a complete 15-second vertical ad.

answer_sheet.Product appearance: Clear straight-sided glass jar with ivory wax, one wick and no label; no photo is available.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Warm evening light, calm mood and gentle camera movement. Setting and shot choices are your call.
answer_sheet.Text: “A little evening calm”, followed by “Find your glow” at the end.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Soft piano, no voice; English text.

must_haves: One playable vertical 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds.
The candle has a clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick and no label.
The candle's design stays consistent across shots.
Warm evening lighting and gentle camera movement create a calm product-ad feel.
“A little evening calm” appears before the closing text “Find your glow”, both spelled exactly.
Soft piano is audible with no speech.

args.name: A Little Evening Calm — Candle Ad

style.prompt: Create a 15-second vertical 9:16 cinematic candle advertisement about a comforting small evening ritual. Product must remain consistent: one clear transparent straight-sided cylindrical glass jar, ivory wax, exactly one centered cotton wick with a small gently flickering flame, absolutely no label, logo, lettering or decoration on the jar. No other candles. Warm evening light, amber and honey tones, soft natural shadows, peaceful intimate home setting, uncluttered wooden tabletop, subtle out-of-focus linen background. Premium realistic product cinematography with restrained gentle camera movement, no fast cuts. Timeline: 0–4 seconds establish the lit candle on the tabletop with a very slow push in, glass rim and ivory wax clearly visible. 4–10 seconds gentle close-up drifting slightly sideways, warm flame reflecting naturally in the clear glass. Show the exact clearly legible elegant overlay text 'A little evening calm' during seconds 3–9, high contrast ivory text in negative space above the candle, no other text. 10–15 seconds settle into a serene hero shot of the same jar, subtle pullback, finish with the exact centered overlay 'Find your glow' from seconds 11–15; previous text disappears before final line. Keep candle fully identifiable and preserve straight glass sides and single wick throughout. Audio: soft sparse solo piano instrumental, comforting slow delicate notes, very quiet and gentle, fading out at the end. No voice, no speech, no singing, no vocals, no percussion. No people, no hands, no extra products, no watermark.
